description: Assigns Mojang UUIDs to players joining an offline-mode server.

mods.name: UUID Fixer
mods.description: Assigns Mojang UUIDs to players joining an offline-mode server, allowing in-game entities and other services (mods like Essential) to use the actual UUID instead of a hash of the player's username.
